comment: Advisories accepted after review. Every entry needs a reason and a review date. CI fails on any other high/critical advisory in runtime dependencies. See docs/security-changes.md (Phase 4).

advisories.reason: Node-only FTP client pulled in by box-typescript-sdk-gen -> proxy-agent -> get-uri. Not part of the plugin bundle (verified with webpack stats); the plugin never opens FTP connections. No fixed version exists. Goes away if the PRO backends are removed (#17).

Pulled in by pcloud-sdk-js, which wrongly lists the build tool @babel/cli as a runtime dependency (-> chokidar -> braces). Not part of the plugin bundle (verified with webpack stats). No fixed version exists. Goes away if the PRO backends are removed (#17).
